info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Replace Meetings Meetings Reschedule-v1-spec
info.description: The Meeting Rescheduling API enables users to modify the schedule of existing meetings. This endpoint allows for efficient updates to meeting times, ensuring that all participants receive timely notifications regarding changes. The API is beneficial for corporate environments where schedules frequently change, enabling seamless coordination among team members. Typical consumers include event coordinators and project managers who rely on timely adjustments to maintain workflow. This functionality enhances productivity by minimizing scheduling conflicts.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to change the scheduled time and date of an existing meeting. It requires identification of the meeting to be rescheduled and the new desired time and date.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to reschedule a meeting. It should contain the necessary information to change the time and date of the specified meeting, along with any other relevant details.

200.description: The meeting has been successfully rescheduled.

requestId.description: The unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the meeting.

customer.description: Information about the customer involved in the meeting.

resource.description: The resource identifier for the meeting.

priority.description: The priority level of the meeting, with lower values indicating higher priority.

amount.description: The amount associated with the meeting transaction.

currency.description: The currency code for the amount.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates if notifications are required for this meeting.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the rescheduling was requested.

channel.description: The communication channel through which the meeting was requested.
